title: Capacity and rate-limit report
summary: Current provider limits and production capacity were measured without exposing credentials or infrastructure identifiers.
evidence: The provider returned a 10,000 requests-per-minute limit.
The provider returned 10,000,000 input tokens per minute and 2,000,000 output tokens per minute.
Production has one CPU core, less than one-half GiB of RAM, and less than one GiB of free disk.
The runtime uses Node 20 and five single-instance application processes were online.
limitations: These are point-in-time observations. Production lacks safe capacity for a full staging copy, so staging remains off-host.
